38. Exploratory testing and UAT

Exploratory testing combines learning, design and execution; user acceptance testing assesses
whether business users accept the system for intended work.

Q: Is UAT the same as exploratory testing?
A: No. UAT focuses on business acceptance; exploratory testing is a learning-driven approach.
